description.text:
Courage (勇) is one of the two booster packs of Brave Stars, alongside Charm (魅). Brave Stars (勇魅群星) was the fifth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 18 June 2024 in 5- and 25-card packs. It brought Pokémon VSTAR, which evolve from Pokémon V and carry a VSTAR Power, an Ability or attack so strong that a player can use only one in a game, and give up two Prize cards when Knocked Out. It also brought Radiant Pokémon, Basic Pokémon with the rarity mark K and strong attacks or Abilities, of which a deck may hold only one, and two new rarities of full-art cards in each artist's own style: Art Rare (AR) and Special Art Rare (SAR).

Courage's headline cards are Lucario V and VSTAR, appearing for the first time, and the Courage sleeves and binder carry Lucario. It also has Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack gives its player another turn, Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, Shaymin VSTAR and Serperior VSTAR; the Radiant Pokémon Venusaur, Hawlucha and Steelix; Art Rares of Hisuian Voltorb, Manaphy, Magnezone and Hisuian Goodra; a Special Art Rare Lumineon V; and the Pokémon Tool Choice Belt. Its main cards are numbered out of 128; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 178.
